title: CapCut Alternative for Auto Captions (No Timeline)
metaDescription: Auto captions without a video editor's timeline: Supertitle transcribes your video, you fix the text like a document, and it exports an MP4.
h1: A CapCut alternative for auto captions, with no timeline
intro: If all you need from CapCut is the captions, Supertitle skips the rest of the editor. There's no timeline to learn: the transcript opens as text, you correct it, pick a style and export.
summary: Auto captions edited as text, without a full editor's timeline.
verdict: Pick Supertitle if captions are the only edit you make and you'd rather correct them as text than on a timeline. Stay with CapCut if you also cut, arrange and add effects to your videos: Supertitle isn't a video editor.

whereTheyWin: Full video editor: CapCut lets you cut and arrange clips, add music, transitions and effects. Supertitle only adds captions, and trims the start and end.
Several clips in one video: CapCut can combine many clips into one edit. Supertitle captions one uploaded video at a time.

switchingSteps.title: Export your edit as usual
switchingSteps.text: Finish the cut in your editor, then upload the MP4, MOV or WEBM to Supertitle.

switchingSteps.title: Fix the captions as text
switchingSteps.text: No timeline: the words are a document. Correct them, split or merge captions, adjust their timing.

switchingSteps.title: Pick a look and export
switchingSteps.text: Choose one of five presets, tweak it, and export an MP4 with the captions burned in.

faq.question: What does 'no timeline' mean?
faq.answer: You don't drag caption blocks along a track. The transcript is a list of captions you read top to bottom: open one to correct its text, and split, merge or retime captions from there.

faq.question: Can I edit my video in Supertitle?
faq.answer: Only the start and the end: you can trim them, and crop the video to 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9. For cuts, music or effects, use a video editor first.

faq.question: Are captions word by word?
faq.answer: Yes. Supertitle transcribes every word with its timing, so styles like Bold Highlight can light up each word as it's spoken.

cta.heading: Caption without the timeline
cta.text: Upload your finished edit and get captions you can fix as text. The free plan has no watermark.
